Use place_on('tray') for the tray and put_aside() to put an item down on a station's table. The drone can scout the stations; the ground robot carries one item at a time. Wind may be blowing.

def skill(robot):
    places = robot.places()
    fruits = ["banana", "pear", "strawberry"]
    tools = ["scissors", "medium clamp"]
    all_items = fruits + tools
    for pl in places:
        robot.drone_scan(pl, all_items)
    for item in all_items:
        dest = "packing station" if item in fruits else "station A"
        fr = item in fruits
        for _ in range(3):
            src = robot.recall(item)
            if src is None:
                for pl in places:
                    robot.drone_scan(pl, [item])
                src = robot.recall(item)
                if src is None: break
            if src == "top shelf":
                robot.drone_fly_over(src)
                if not robot.drone_grab(item):
                    robot.drone_scan(src, [item])
                    continue
                robot.drone_fly_over(dest)
                if fr:
                    if robot.drone_drop_into("tray"): break
                elif robot.drone_drop_into(dest): break
                continue
            if not robot.go_to(src): continue
            if not robot.sees(item):
                robot.drone_scan(src, [item])
                continue
            if not robot.pick(item): continue
            robot.go_to(dest)
            if fr:
                if robot.place_on("tray"): break
            elif robot.put_aside(): break
    return True
